meta.name: Coffee shop
meta.description: Customers arrive about every 2 minutes at random; one till serves them in about 1.5 minutes, also at random (spec 1's example, examples/coffee_shop.json). The run is 200 h long including 10 h of warm-up, so 190 h are measured. M/M/1 theory: utilization 0.75, mean wait 4.5 min, 2.25 waiting, 6 min in the shop, 3 customers inside (Little's law).
